title: 第6581章 你们都给我听好了第6580章 我也是第一次看到
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 戎汐却是摇摇头说道：“这种妖兽对我没有任何用处，甚至不管是谁拍下，恐怕都活不了多久。”
“你能看得出来？”
这倒是让苏辰感到惊讶不已。
不过，苏辰没有多问。
毕竟每个人都有着属于自己的秘密，包括自己在内都一样。
苏辰没有出手，就这样静静地看着水幕上的第三件宝物。
大帝妖兽精血，对于苏辰来说也是好东西，不过却是没有出手竞价。
在苏辰看来，自己要是想要得到大帝精血，完全可以去想其他办法，在拍卖会进行拍卖，大帝精血的价格会提升数倍，完全是不值得的事情。
接下来拍卖的商品，品级都不是很低。
但是对于苏辰来说，没有继续出手。
在苏辰看来。
要是商品有用，无论付出什么样的代价都是值得的事情，但要是商品无用，那么就算是拿出一枚丹药，他都不愿意。
戎汐看到苏辰一直没有继续竞价，也是有些惊讶。
“都看不上？”
“不是看不上，而是不需要。”
西域，须弥祭界。
天梦族。
如今的天梦族，则是十二位族老，三十六位长老全部齐聚，一个比一个脸色难看。
“颖姐，到底发生什么事情了。”
小茵很明显能感应得出来，族内似乎有什么大事发生，只是她们的身份太低，根本无从得知。
颖姐却是摇摇头，显得很是无奈，说道：“不知道，但十二位族老和三十六位长老全部齐聚，此事肯定不简单。”
“你怎么了？”
“我想苏辰了。”
噗！
颖姐差点被自己的口水噎到，说道：“我的小茵妹妹，你是不是又犯花痴了，你明明知道，族长很有可能和苏辰有关系，你还敢惦记苏辰，是不是不想活了。”
“颖姐，谣言就是谣言，以族长的身份，怎么可能看上苏辰，当我不一样，那么多男宠，苏辰是第一个让我心动的人，他却是选择离了”
颖姐却是无奈地摇摇头，说道：“狗屁谣言，你我都知道，那不是谣言，苏辰和族长肯定有关系，只是你我不知道而已。”
心里深深叹息一声，小茵当然明白颖姐的意思。
她肯定希望这是谣言，只是整个族内传得有鼻子有眼，正所谓无风不起浪，怎么可能的事情。
显得很是无奈，小茵也不知道自己是怎么回事。
content_en:
Rong tide shook his head and said: "This kind of monster is of no use to me, and no matter who takes the picture, I'm afraid they won't live long."
"Can you tell?"
"Yeah."
This surprised Su Chen.
However, Su Chen didn't ask any more questions.
After all, everyone has their own secrets, including yourself.
Su Chen didn't take any action, just looked at the third treasure on the water curtain quietly.
The blood of the emperor's monster beast was also a good thing for Su Chen, but he did not bid for it.
From Su Chen's point of view, if he wanted to obtain the Emperor's essence and blood, he could think of other ways. If he auctioned it at an auction, the price of the Emperor's essence and blood would increase several times, which was completely unworthy.
The goods to be auctioned next are not of very low quality.
But for Su Chen, he did not continue to take action.
In Su Chen's view.
If the product is useful, it is worth paying no matter what the price is. But if the product is useless, then he is not willing to take out a pill.
Rong tide was also a little surprised when he saw that Su Chen had not continued bidding.
"You don't even like it?"
"It's not that I don't like it, it's that I don't need it."
~~~~~~~~~
Western Region, Xumi Sacrifice World.
Tianmeng tribe.
Today, there are twelve clan elders and thirty-six elders of the Tianmeng clan gathered together, each one looking uglier than the last.
"Sister Ying, what happened?"
Xiao Yin can obviously sense that something big seems to be happening within the clan, but their status is too low and they have no way of knowing.
Sister Ying shook her head, looking very helpless, and said, "I don't know, but with all twelve clan elders and thirty-six elders gathered together, this matter must not be simple."
"What's wrong with you?"
"I miss Su Chen."
Poof!
Sister Ying almost choked on her own saliva and said, "My sister Xiaoyin, are you a nymphomaniac again? You clearly know that the patriarch is likely to have a relationship with Su Chen, but you still dare to worry about Su Chen. Do you not want to live anymore?"
"Sister Ying, rumors are just rumors. As the leader of the clan, how could he fall in love with Su Chen and think that I am different? There are so many male favorites. Su Chen was the first one to make my heart beat, but he chose to leave."
"Shh!"
Sister Ying shook her head helplessly and said, "Both you and I know the bullshit rumors. They are not rumors. Su Chen must be related to the clan leader, but you and I don't know about it."
With a deep sigh in her heart, Xiao Yin certainly understood what Sister Ying meant.
She definitely hoped that this was a rumor that spread throughout the clan. As the saying goes, there is no smoke without fire, how could it be possible?
She looked very helpless, and Xiao Yin didn't know what was going on with her.
